channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japan coach Eddie Jones praises Scotland counterpart Gregor Townsend
item.description: The veteran Australian boss brings Japan to Murrayfield for a Nations Championship clash on Saturday.

item.title: Nepalese police detain 35 Japanese nationals over suspected online fraud
item.description: It is unusual for Japanese nationals to be linked to such fraud in Nepal.

item.title: First-half profit falls at two out of three major Japan nonlife insurers
item.description: Higher U.S. interest rates and more natural disasters in the country spurred the drops, according to their earnings reports.

item.title: Japan Tobacco hit by $8.9 billion charge on Russia seizure
item.description: The Tokyo-based company now expects an operating loss of ¥368 billion instead of a ¥1 trillion profit.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
